steps.caption: The Schedule
steps.narration: This is the Schedule. Every visit and appointment you book shows up on this calendar.

steps.caption: Month, Week, Agenda
steps.narration: Month, Week and Agenda change how much you see. Let's switch to Week.

steps.caption: Add
steps.narration: To book a visit, choose Add.

steps.caption: Date
steps.narration: Pick the date. We'll make it tomorrow.

steps.caption: Link a client
steps.narration: Link it to a client, so the visit also shows on their page.

steps.caption: Crew
steps.narration: Tick who is going. Priya will take this one.

steps.caption: On the calendar
steps.narration: The visit is on the calendar.

steps.caption: My calendar or everyone's
steps.narration: This list chooses whose calendar you see. My calendar shows the visits you booked or are going to. Everyone's calendar shows the whole team.

steps.caption: The whole team's week
steps.narration: Now the crew's jobs are here too. You can also pick one person from the same list.

steps.caption: Open a visit to change it
steps.narration: To change a visit, click it.

steps.caption: New start
steps.narration: Change what you need. We'll move this one to one o'clock.

steps.caption: Save changes
steps.narration: Choose Save changes, and the calendar is up to date.

steps.caption: Menu: Schedule
steps.narration: You'll find Schedule in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to schedule and edit an appointment | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Schedule in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will add an appointment, link it to a client and choose who is going. Then you will switch between your own calendar and everyone's, and change a visit's time.
